resolution.question: Will Brightline Software's three co-founders decide whether the January price increase is going ahead, and tell the team, before the all-hands on the 18th?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that, before 2026-12-18T10:00:00-08:00, all three co-founders have collectively decided whether the January price increase is going ahead (i.e., reached a final decision, either yes or no) AND that decision has been communicated to the team (e.g., via an announcement, email, or meeting). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
